mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with immediate economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not lead to tightening.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of housing starts and unemployment rate changes does not correlate with economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances with strong PAYEMS growth, or PAYEMS growth does not correlate with labor market strength.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 declines do not correlate with economic slowdowns during tightening cycles.
